  Adjourned Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, June 3, 2025  5:00 PM  Council Chamber

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk.

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

3.  ROLL CALL

4  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS
  This is the appropriate time for members of the public to make comments regarding items not listed on this
  agenda. If you would like to address the City Council, please complete a speaker sheet and give to the City
  Clerk. Under the State's open meeting law - the Brown Act - no action may be taken on any item not on the
  agenda.

5.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 AND 2026-2027 BUDGET STUDY SESSION
  Recommendation: That the City Council review the information and discuss the
  programs and services to allow staff to prepare the final budget for presentation
  and public hearing on June 24, 2025.
  Attachments: FY 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 Draft Budget
